title: Miguel Braga
html: Miguel is ADEE’s resident tech wizard, graphic designer by passion, web developer by logic, tech support by destiny - he keeps ADEE online andlooking good. When he’s not turning design chaos into clean layouts or rescuing websites from digital disasters, he’s probably tweaking pixels no one else will ever notice. Coffee-powered and always curious, he wears more hats than a fashion week runway and the reason “turning it off and on again” occasionally works.
